svg.title: Where the existing tests enter the scheduler
svg.desc: Every TEST in the scheduler package placed under the earliest pipeline stage it calls directly, coloured by test file. Computed from the test sources.

g.text: Where the existing tests enter the scheduler

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Each card is one TEST, placed under the earliest stage it calls. "+n" means it also calls n later stages. Most job-level behaviour is only tested end to end through Plan().

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
